name: Uplifter / downlifter from any saw synth: pitch-bend span, closed LP, accelerating LFO
goal: Create mix-ready uplifters and downlifters in any wavetable/subtractive synth: hold the root note for ~8 bars, set pitch-bend range to ±6 or ±12 st, close a 12 dB low-pass, map an LFO with an accelerating curve (quarter→eighth→sixteenth) to cutoff and to pitch-bend (50%→100% for up, 50%→0% for down), thicken with unison, then sidechain and add reverb/FX.

source.title: HOW TO MAKE UPLIFTERS & DOWNLIFTERS IN SERUM!!!

prerequisites: Synth with pitch-bend range, low-pass filter, drawable/tempo LFO, unison

inputs.name: bend_range_st
inputs.description: Pitch-bend range in semitones (transcript suggests 6 or 12)

constraints: Portable signal-flow recipe for Web Audio / Traveler-inspired / any hybrid synth with comparable modules; not affiliated with any vendor.
Do not copy proprietary factory preset banks, wavetable file names, or sample packs; use original/free waves or generic shapes.
Steps and numeric values are grounded only in the YouTube Show-transcript text; approximate where the speaker gestured without stating a number.
Do not rely on named commercial preset packs; apply the same bend+filter+LFO recipe to an init saw or any original lead patch.
Sidechain depth is mix-dependent; transcript example pulls a kick-sidechain mix to ~75%.

steps.action: In the piano roll, draw a single root-note held for about 8 bars so the riser sits in key for a buildup.
steps.expect: One sustained note spanning the transition

steps.action: Set pitch-bend range to 6 or 12 semitones up and down (12 used in the transcript).
steps.expect: Full-wheel (or 100% bend mod) equals the chosen span

steps.action: Enable a low-pass filter (e.g. MG-style 12 dB) and pull cutoff down so highs are removed at the start.
Map an LFO to cutoff. Draw an accelerating rate curve in the LFO (start slower ~1/4, then 1/8, then 1/16) and adjust LFO rate to taste.
steps.expect: Filter opens with increasing urgency over the clip

steps.action: Map the same (or a second) LFO/envelope to pitch-bend position: from 50% toward 100% for an uplifter, or from 50% toward 0% for a downlifter.
steps.expect: Pitch rises or falls across the held note in sync with the filter

steps.action: On a saw source, raise unison (e.g. ~7 voices), reduce detune for a tighter supersaw, and raise stereo blend slightly.
steps.expect: Thicker, wider riser without extreme beating

steps.action: Sidechain the riser to the kick (or a rhythmic duck envelope), easing mix if the duck is harsh (~75% wet in the transcript example). Add reverb/FX from the synth FX rack or inserts so it sits in the mix.
steps.expect: Riser pumps with the groove and has space without masking the kick

verification: Uplifter: pitch and brightness increase over the 8 bars; downlifter: both decrease
At bend center (50%) with filter closed the static tone is in key and dull
Sidechain produces audible ducking against the kick
